ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a unity negative feedback control system. The input U(s) enters a summing point with a positive sign, and the output Y(s) is directly fed back through the lower branch to the negative terminal of the summing point; in the forward path there is only one block, labeled Ke^{-s}/s inside the block, and the output terminal is labeled Y(s). Reasoning: From the figure, the open-loop transfer function can be obtained as L(s)=K e^{-s}/s. Let s=jω, then L(jω)=K e^{-jω}/(jω). Among them, the integrating link 1/(jω) provides a -90° phase, and the pure delay e^{-jω} provides a -ω radians phase, namely -ω·180/π degrees. Therefore ∠L(jω)=-90°-ω·180/π. When the phase margin PM=30°, at the gain crossover frequency there should be ∠L(jω_gc)=-180°+30°=-150°. So -90°-ω_gc·180/π=-150°, solving gives ω_gc=π/3 rad/s. The gain crossover condition is |L(jω_gc)|=1, and |e^{-jω}|=1, so |L(jω_gc)|=K/ω_gc=1, therefore K=ω_gc=π/3≈1.047, and according to the problem's answer it is taken as approximately 1.04.

method.method_draft: Form the loop transfer function from the image: L(s)=K e^{-s}/s. For PM=30°, require ∠L(jω_gc)=-150°. Since ∠L(jω)=-90°-ω·180/π, solve -90°-ω_gc·180/π=-150° to get ω_gc=π/3 rad/s. Then impose the gain-crossover condition |L(jω_gc)|=K/ω_gc=1, giving K=ω_gc=π/3≈1.04.

推理：由图可得开环传递函数为 L(s)=K e^{-s}/s。令 s=jω，则 L(jω)=K e^{-jω}/(jω)。其中积分环节 1/(jω) 提供 -90° 相位，纯延时 e^{-jω} 提供 -ω 弧度相位，即 -ω·180/π 度。因此 ∠L(jω)=-90°-ω·180/π。相位裕度 PM=30° 时，在增益交叉频率处应有 ∠L(jω_gc)=-180°+30°=-150°。所以 -90°-ω_gc·180/π=-150°，解得 ω_gc=π/3 rad/s。增益交叉条件为 |L(jω_gc)|=1，而 |e^{-jω}|=1，故 |L(jω_gc)|=K/ω_gc=1，因此 K=ω_gc=π/3≈1.047，按题目答案取约为 1.04。
